title: Tomos Pack
description: Tomos Pack is a client-side modpack that adds helpful tweaks and quality-of-life improvements without changing gameplay or affecting servers. It’s perfect for enhancing your Minecraft experience while staying fully compatible with vanilla multiplayer.
body:
🌍 **Tomos Pack – A Smoother, Smarter Minecraft**

Tomos Pack is a lightweight, client-side-only Minecraft modpack built to improve your experience without changing the heart of the game. Whether you're new to modding or just want a smoother, more polished version of Minecraft, Tomos Pack delivers subtle but powerful quality-of-life improvements that work seamlessly in singleplayer and on vanilla multiplayer servers.

There’s no need to set up a special server or learn complex mods. Just install the pack, launch the game, and enjoy Minecraft—only better.

✨ **Features**

- Client-side only: No need to install anything on a server. Tomos Pack works with vanilla servers and realms.

- Quality of life improvements: Small tweaks that make a big difference—like better tooltips, smoother menus, and clearer interfaces.

- Performance boosts: Optimization mods to help your game run faster and more efficiently, even on lower-end PCs.

- Better visuals: Clean visual enhancements that don’t overdo it—think improved lighting, clearer UI, and subtle polish (no shaders required).

- Zero gameplay changes: No new blocks, mobs, or items—just improvements to what’s already there.

- Perfect for casual and multiplayer players: Stay compatible with friends who play vanilla while still getting an upgraded experience.

🛠️ **What You Can Expect**

- Tomos Pack includes popular and reliable client-side mods that aim to:

- Smooth out frame rates

- Add info like tool durability and mob health

- Improve inventory management

- Enhance the interface and menus

- Make controls and tooltips more intuitive

- All without affecting game balance or requiring any knowledge of modding.

🎮 **Why Choose Tomos Pack?**
If you love the feel of vanilla Minecraft but want it to be more user-friendly, optimized, and just a bit smarter—Tomos Pack is for you. It’s great for casual players, builders, explorers, and anyone who just wants a better experience without the complexity of full modded Minecraft.

✅ **Easy to Install – Zero Server Setup Needed**
No server-side mods, no configuration headaches. Just install the pack through your Modrinth or CurseForge launcher, and you're good to go.
